modular_backpacks.title: Modular Backpacks
modular_backpacks.body:
![Minecraft style mod logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf1fd8fcafd26c35d3d6f2e40f1240119c67647a.png)

![Row of all of the items from my mod for visual flair](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd132aeb5cba480266a4cfc1b37d2baf4363bce4.png)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/sAVmcmbyo1U" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![Row of all of the items from my mod for visual flair](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd132aeb5cba480266a4cfc1b37d2baf4363bce4.png)

Modular backpacks focuses entirely on one backpack and making that the best it can be.  
Instead of direct upgrades, backpacks use a swappable module system that lets you build your own backpack tailored to your playstyle.  
Enchantments can even change how your backpack functions entirely.  
  
This mod is primarily designed to be an in-depth and (somewhat) balanced alternative to other backpack mods, with some more Vanilla-esque design mannerisms.  
  

#   Features

##    Backpack

*   Backpack with 9 slots of storage and 4 module slots
*   Each module slotted shows visually on your backpack for you and others
*   Dye and Trim support for backpacks
*   Backpack dye color changes the color of its GUI
*   Elytras, Create Goggles, Create Backtanks, Spyglasses, and Jukeboxes are supported in module slots  
      
## 8 different modules  
      
*   Pouch - standard storage module
*   Farming Pot - allows for portable crop growth
*   Quiver - stores arrows and imbues them with the effects of inserted suspicious stew
*   Buckler - provides armor to make up for the lack of a chestplate
*   Sack - can store one type of item in bulk
*   Cooking Pot - smelts items very slowly but at no fuel cost
*   Echo Pouch - module equivalent of an ender chest (can hold shulker boxes, unlike other modules)
*   Climbing Gear - allows you to climb on and jump off of walls  
      
    (most modules have at least 1 upgrade)  
      

## 4 Backpack Enchantments
    
*   Linking - worn backpack stays on death (treasure loot found in Ancient and End Cities)
*   Back Protection - significantly reduces damage from behind
*   Rationing - extra hunger you don't have room for is stored and fed back to you when out of combat
*   Packing - your base backpack inventory now works like a very large bundle  
      
    

# Mod Integration

***

*   Curios
*   Farmers Delight (and various Farmers Delight addons) 
*   Neapolitan 
*   Serene Seasons
*   JEI
*   Create
*   Immersive Overlays
*   Spyglass Improvements
*   Various modded trim materials are partially supported
*   Various modded elytras are partially supported  
      
    
*   Modded trim textures can be added with Resource Packs
*   Farming Pot recipes (including what seasons crops can be grown in) can be entirely changed or even added (for unsupported mods) with data packs  
      
    
*   Config exists for storage sizes, changing functionality, and disabling modules/enchantments entirely

***

  -Language Credits-
  Simplified Chinese - spake32
  Canadian French - BearPolice
  Brazilian Portugese - ShadyGlasses 
  Portugal Portugese - WereBlount 
  Spain Spanish - Adrix
  Chilean Spanish - HoneyVee
  Russia Russian - PonPonchik 
  Arabic - sh3fan
  
  -Trailer Help- 
  HoneyVee  
  Pyrodisc
  
This mod was partially inspired by my personal favorite backpack mod, Beans Backpacks  
Join the mod Discord to report issues, suggest new features, or ask questions.

places.title: Places
places.body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1472650cc952809b689e6a7c885b7284832306cc.png)

A little mod adding 4 new dimensions (plus a couple small sub dimensions) heavily inspired by other popular liminal places/aesthetics to the game, alongside new mobs, items, paintings, music discs and blocks (obviously).

Most of the relevant information about the features of the mod can actually be found through the **item tooltips** and **advancements** so be sure to look in there if you wanna learn about how some of the features work. Otherwise you can also join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/Xk7BVWhTex) and just ask about stuff directly in there!

**Also for ppl with photosensitivity:** the mod does contain a thing with **FLASHING LIGHTS**, and as of the latest update there is a photosensitivity config (that hopefully works).

## Dependencies
- Requires [Backbone](https://modrinth.com/mod/backbone) for generation
- Requires [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) for some of the blocks textures, alternatives should work too but if its some vibecoded fork dont complain to me (the mod works without it just some of the blocks dont look as good)

## Mod compatability
- Has built in compat with [Chalk](https://modrinth.com/mod/chalk-mod) (adds recipes to obtain chalks in the Places)
- Has built in compat with [Gallery](https://modrinth.com/mod/gallery)
- Has a tiny compat with [Neapolitan](https://modrinth.com/mod/neapolitan), [Environmental](https://modrinth.com/mod/environmental) and [Atmospheric](https://modrinth.com/mod/atmospheric) (just adds a couple recipes for food items)
- (not compatible with 0.5 atm, will get an update soon tm)There is a [Places + Exposure: Polaroid compat](https://modrinth.com/datapack/places-+-exposure-polaroid-compat) datapack to integrate [Exposure](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure) and [Exposure: Polaroid](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure-polaroid) with the mod (includes loot pool changes, room changes and custom findable photos)

## Music
All of the background tracks have been made by my awesome friend **LudoCrypt** so go check out her [Bandcamp](https://ludocrypt.bandcamp.com/music) if you wanna listen to it and also go buy her music.
Most of the level discs are made by [WebCreature](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyjXoaQvCOS5QEF3rkAnXFg)! go check out their music on their [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1CY7JoQn2njPp9tyuLD71s)

![Banner2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1941b10b67cbd6ddb5d15949f89f16275f661009_0.webp)
## 
Feel free to use the mod in your modpacks AS LONG as there is no generative AI used in them **anywhere** :)
places.summary: A liminal space minecraft mod focusing on making exploring them a fun survival sandbox experience

quark.title: Quark
quark.body:
[![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/vm0.png)](https://violetmoon.org)[![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/vm1.png)](https://patreon.com/vazkii)[![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/vm2.png)](https://twitter.com/vazkiimods)[![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/vm3.png)](https://discord.gg/vm)
![](https://violetmoon.org/branding/hero/quark.png)

---

# About

Warning: Quark **[Requires Zeta](https://modrinth.com/mod/zeta)** for 1.20.1 onwards, or **[AutoRegLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/autoreglib)** for 1.19.2 and prior.

**Quark** is a fully modular minecraft mod, named after the subatomic particle. In simpler terms, it's a large mod with lots of small features, aimed at improving the vanilla game. 
Every feature can be turned on and off individually at your will, and most features contain further options to tweak the game just how you like it.

With quark installed, the title screen will get a new "q" button added to it. This button allows you to configure quark from inside the game, so you can easily turn off any features you don't vibe with.

---

# Features

Quark has over a hundred different modules to play with, but here's a small highlight reel of our favorites:

* Feeding Trough, for automatic animal breeding
* Pistons Push Tile Entities, just like in Bedrock Edition
* Japanese and Industrial style building blocks
* Variant versions for Bookshelves, Chests, and Ladders for all wood types
* Vertical Slabs, for all slabs already in the base game and Quark
* Advanced Camera Mode for fancy screenshots
* Toretoises, typo intended - new underground animals that grow ore on their back
* Pickarang, a pickaxe that can be thrown as a boomerang
* Trowel, a new tool to place random blocks from your hotbar, for paths or ruins
* Emote system, allowing your character to do all sorts of motions from the chat menu
* Reacharound Placing, which lets you place blocks under other blocks without being able to see the bottom face
* Azalea Wood, replacing the Oak wood in Azalea trees with a pleasant green
* Glimmering Weald, a new rare deep underground biome with glowing mushrooms and a cute new stone fae mob

And many, many more!

---

# Learn more about Quark today
### Visit the **[Official Website](https://quarkmod.net/)**

* Visit the [Old Website](https://quarkmod.net/old) (for Minecraft versions 1.12 and prior)
* Check out [what changed](https://vazkii.notion.site/Quark-3-0-Forge-1-18-Release-Notes-f22ef705b677421585f1208156a82b44) between Quark for 1.16 and Quark for 1.18
* Download [Quark Oddities](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/quark-oddities), an addon focusing on more complex and technical features

---

# Compatibility

Quark has built-in compatibility for a few mods, including JEI and TerraBlender.

Quark may be incompatible with Optifine. If you are having issues using the two together, please uninstall Optifine and use a Sodium fork instead. 

Additionally, if you are experiencing load crashes on 1.20.1, make sure your other mods are up to date, as any mods with integration from older versions will not function until updated.

---

jaams_weaponry.title: Jaam's Weaponry
jaams_weaponry.body:
## 📖 Overview: **Jaam’s Weaponry** is a vanilla+ combat expansion designed to greatly broaden the range of playstyles available to players. Focused on expanding and refining Minecraft’s combat system, the mod introduces a large collection of new weapons, each with its own unique mechanics and behaviors that make every fight feel distinct and impactful. The mod introduces a wide variety of new armaments while also reworking and enhancing the existing vanilla arsenal and the equipment used by vanilla mobs. These improvements make both new and familiar weapons feel more cohesive, balanced, and exciting to use throughout the game’s progression. It aims to make combat more immersive, strategic, and rewarding by encouraging players to master timing, movement, and creativity. Each weapon addition allows players to develop their own fighting style and adapt to new challenges, offering fresh approaches to both PvE and PvP encounters.


## 🎯 Features: - **+50 new weapons, including tiered, unique, ranged, and firearms.** - **+50 new weapon abilities and mechanics.** - **New effects, enchantments, and advancements.** - **Improved vanilla mob enemy equipment.** - **Vanilla combat and weapons improvements.** - **Weapon skins and easter eggs.** - **Dedicated mod compatibility.** - **Advanced tooltips system.** - **Extensive configuration options.** - **And more!**
Spoiler

create.body:
## Installation Requirements

This version of Create runs on Forge and NeoForge. Install one of these loaders before adding Create to your game.
Alternatively, you can find a ported project compatible with the Fabric ecosystem here.
As of 0.5.1, the rendering library Flywheel no longer has to be installed separately.

## About

Welcome to Create, a mod offering a variety of tools and blocks for Building, Decoration and Aesthetic Automation.

The added elements of tech are designed to leave as many design choices to the player as possible. With Create, the game isn't played inside a bunch of UIs, it challenges you to setup contraptions of animated components working together in many possible arrangements.

Create's visual in-game documentation called 'Ponder' will guide you though all added mechanics and gadgets.

Important: In order to be able to see all recipes required in Create, consider installing JEI. The vanilla recipe book will not be able to guide you through the experience by itself.

magistuarmory.title: Epic Knights: Shields Armor and Weapons
magistuarmory.body:
![top_image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e67e18f8e368cf1bbdfe006ab8941516ee60cec.webp)
![bh_description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/177f84af906fb27f250597f47f2342cafd66048b.webp)
This mod aims to give Minecraft a more medieval knight-inspired feel. Epic Knights adds historically inspired armor, weapons, heraldry and customization to Minecraft, with an emphasis on making different medieval equipment visually and mechanically distinct. The weapons have unique properties, such as increased attack range, armor-piercing, two-handed, blocking and dismounting capabilities.

Banners can be attached to armor and horse armor in the same way they can be attached to shields. Also there're decorations for armor, such as plumes and crowns, many of which can be dyed in any color.

The mod adds steel as a new material. Steel can be crafted by smelting an iron ingot in a blast furnace.

Configuration files are in config/epicknights folder.

malum.title: Malum
malum.body:
![MalumLogo](https://imgur.com/1ANraFD.png)

Introduction

Malum is a dark magic mod centered around spirit arcana; a dark study of soul magic. It's divided into several interpretations of the strange field of magic, which the player will explore through the use of the Encyclopedia Arcana, a strange journal written by an unknown author.


![An introduction to the mod](https://i.imgur.com/CKuQmHN.png)
![https://i.imgur.com/NZZgKVj.png](https://i.imgur.com/NZZgKVj.png)
 

 

The codex will provide you with everything you need to get started. The codex is very open ended, allowing players to choose their own path. Malum offers little restriction to the order in which any player does things. You're free to prioritize whichever parts of the mod interest you most.

 

Natural Wonders

 
![https://i.imgur.com/4obSmZn.png](https://i.imgur.com/4obSmZn.png)
 

Not every color of magic is so grim and dark. Runewood Trees are a mixture of nature and magic, fitted with bark made for magic and a complete set of wood blocks. 

 
![https://i.imgur.com/qFwS6Y7.png](https://i.imgur.com/qFwS6Y7.png)
 

The mod also adds plenty of underground ores for you to find, cthonic gold, soulstone, natural quartz.. and even more that I'll leave up to you to discover. 

 

Spirit Magics

 
![https://i.imgur.com/CquZC9W.png](https://i.imgur.com/CquZC9W.png)
 

Functioning as the core system to utilizing spirit arcana, Spirit infusion is a magical process through which the player will create all sorts of miracles. 

 
![https://i.imgur.com/SbIVVBp.png](https://i.imgur.com/SbIVVBp.png)
 

Spirit focusing is another powerful system that will accompany you in your daily life. The magic allows you to materialize new resources out of thin air using raw spirit matter.

 
![https://i.imgur.com/ziTDp4N.png](https://i.imgur.com/ziTDp4N.png)
![https://i.imgur.com/ElM3QtM.png](https://i.imgur.com/ElM3QtM.png)
 

Through spirit magics you'll be able to create a lot of new and exciting gear. Trinkets, armor, tools, weapons, and even more.

Each trinket and armor set provides it's own unique effect, some even offering some synnergy potential.

 
![https://i.imgur.com/3Msyag7.png](https://i.imgur.com/3Msyag7.png)
 

Totem magic allows you to utilize spirit arcana for various unique effects, each spirit has it's own rituals it allows you to utilize.

 

There's lots to Malum, these are only just a few things I decided to showcase. I encourage you to try the mod for yourself, and see what else it's hiding.

 

Information

- If you like the mod, check out my [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/sammysemicolon)!

- To use the mod, you will need to download [Lodestone](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lodestone) as well as [Curios Api](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios)

- If you've got any questions, feel free to leave a comment or preferably visit my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/JFMwSQsebV)
malum.summary: Malum - A minecraft mod about dark magic.

alexscaves.title: Alex's Caves
alexscaves.body:
![Alex's Caves](https://i.imgur.com/aVLosAP.png)

This mod requires Citadel

 

Alex’s Caves is a Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds 6 new cave biomes to the Overworld. Unlike most normal biomes, these cave biomes are exceedingly rare - yet they all contain a variety of unique blocks, items, mobs and mechanics that makes them considerable subterranean destinations. These six biomes are the Magnetic Caves, the Primordial Caves, the Toxic Caves, the Abyssal Chasm,  the Forlorn Hollows and the Candy Cavity. 

 

To find any of these cave biomes, you’ll need to discover an Underground Cabin anywhere in the overworld. From there, you will find loot barrels with cave tablets and a Cave Compendium - a guide book for Alex’s Caves that should provide you with all the knowledge needed to find and explore any biome added by the mod. For more information on getting started, see the ‘[Getting Started](https://alexscaves.wiki.gg/wiki/Guides/Getting_Started)’ section on the mod’s wiki.

 

Alex’s Caves is a very large mod with a great deal of effort put into the look and feel of each new biome. Each biome added may have its own ambient particles, fog, brightness, light color and more. Because of this, it is recommended to experience this mod without shaders, since many shaders can alter or worsen the unique appearance of several of the biomes. The mod also has built-in compatibility with Just Enough Items and Alex’s Mobs.

 
Any additional questions can be answered on the [Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/alexsmods), and bugs can be reported on [Github](https://github.com/AlexModGuy/AlexsCaves).

burnt.title: Burnt + Additions
burnt.body:
**Burnt 1.10 is finally here!**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/HEizwboHxco?si=_OZGH7UwYpkkFRMN" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Join the Discord: [https://discord.gg/NUqTwsfTzn](https://discord.gg/NUqTwsfTzn)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/srnCSouUzrk?si=LvuxUpRzyCvCriAY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Fire**

We've watched it, played with it, and shouted angrily at it in Minecraft since the early early days. But it's not great, behaves badly, takes things from us and doesn't give back... so what if it could be something better?

This is BURNT. A Vanilla fire enhancing mod, if you light it, it will burn... Not disappear... BURN. In return, wooden structures and trees remain, burnt and twisted, and with resources you can use.

Finally a good use for the flint and steel. Light a log, a wooden structure, a village, even grass, and up it goes. Fire spreads realistically and the view is a pyromaniac's dream.

**Burnt Mechanic:**

- Use flint and steel on and wooden/leaves/grass block to trigger the burn
- The block will smoulder, then burn and spread to adjacent blocks
- When the block has gone out the burnt block variant remains
- Randomly, broken versions of the block can replace the block - break these for Charcoal
- Ash will spawn from solid burning blocks if you have the Supplementaries mod installed
- Craft or find the Flint Bow to fire burning arrows, (requires arrows) and trigger the burn
- Fire the Flint Bow at a Creeper to ignite it from a distance
- Craft or find Fire Barrels - Ignite with flint and steel, burning arrows, or redstone.
- Craft even more powerful Blaze Barrels.
- After a short delay, the barrel will explode with blast damage and trigger the burn to surrounding blocks
- Craft or find the Fire Extinguisher to put out fires.
- Rain will also extinguish fire
- You can also get burnt wood by placing wood in a smoker
- Burning builds will now experience random collapse events
- Fire barrel explosions cause blocks to break and fall
- Use the config file to adjust your settings.
- The config file will be generated the first time you load the mod, and can be found in the configs folder. When changing settings you will need to reload your world for them to take effect.

**Dependencies:**

- Requires Geckolib and Cloth Config

**Compatible with:**

- Most Biome mods - Biomes a plenty, Oh the Biomes we've gone, Regions Unexplored etc
- Tree Chop
- Pollution of the Realms
- Supplimentaries

**I am working on compats for:**

- Quark 
- Spore
- Alex's Caves
- Decorative Blocks
- Create

**Tips:**


- Rain in the world will stop the spread of fire, water will extinguish any block on fire.
- Gamerule DoFireTick=False will stop all fire spread.
- Smokers will create burnt wood types with any wood.
- Back up any worlds you don't want to be destroyed by fire!
- Works server-side, however... largely untested.
- Works best with shaders, obvs. Lots of glowy things.
- Play with the config all you like, just be aware - dialing things up to 10 will likely lead to crashes!
- If you use wool for your redstone builds you can turn wool burning off in the config
- Have fun, it's a toy!
- I take no responsibility for your burnt base, sorry, not sorry.


Yes it's MCreator... hate away!

I've done lots of testing, but no doubt there will be more bugs! Please report all bugs here on my discord: [https://discord.gg/NUqTwsfTzn](https://discord.gg/NUqTwsfTzn)
burnt.summary: A Vanilla fire enhancing mod, if you light it, it will burn. Build your world and burn it down!

starcatcher.title: Starcatcher
starcatcher.body:
**Starcatcher** adds a new fishing mini-game, tackle boxes, baits, trophies, fishing hats, tournaments and everything else an angler could ask for 🎣 There are **100+** new fishes ready for you to catch and record in your catalogue, uniquely restricted by biome, weather, daytime, elevation and more! *** ## ✨ Perfect Your Skill ✨ **Starcatcher** features a new skill-based minigame! Master the art of fishing and catch all 100+ new unique fish

![Fishing a cod in a river, as one usually does](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84a97bbca6db96a9d35b81c33aa5917596665d47.png) *** ## 📝 Catalog Your Catches📝 Every fish you catch will be recorded, keeping track of your best catches and much more!

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_cc07e5e4-249d-400b-abc8-15008ba5c7ae.png) ![Salmon Entry](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_74c2d48b-7f32-4edc-96a0-d8cc0f19d18d.png) *** ## 🐟🐡🐠 Starcatcher has a lot of features waiting for you! 🐠🐡🐟 * 🎣 **Hooks, Bobbers, and Baits** for your rod * 🐡 **100+ Unique fish** with different size, weight, and fishing conditions * 🐛 **Tackle Boxes** to store your fish and swap your rod attachments * 🔥 Unique **Minigame** gimmicks for different fishes * 🏆 **Trophies** to reward your progression * 🕵️‍♀️ **Catalogue** to record all your catches * 🏆 **Fishing Tournaments** to challenge your friends * ♒ **Aquariums** to showcase your best catches * 😮 **Display** block to showcase your progress to your friends * 🕵️‍♀️ **Secrets Messages** left for you to find * 📜 **Message-in-a-Bottle** to share your stories with the server * 🤑 **Selling bin** to turn your catches into money * 🥇 **Golden Fish** for those who want only the best * 👒 Different **Cosmetics** to show your fashion sense * 🎣 **Fishable Entities** to fish live fish * 🔧 Built-in **Compatibility** with fish from other mods *** ## 🔎Will you fill out your collection? 🔎 Some of these catches are harder than they appear! *** ## 🎣 Tackle Boxes🎣 Tackle boxes allow you to store your Fish, Hooks, Bobbers, Baits, as well as modify your Rod Attachements! It's important to use the correct attachments when hunting for **Legendary** fish 🎣 ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_905b6815-335b-44ef-820f-a67569064093.png) *** ## ♒ Aquariums ♒ Display your catches in the new **Aquarium** multi-block! Customize it to your liking with different decorations and fish. Starcaught fish placed inside will be scaled based on their size & weight percentile 🤏

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_dbab7b05-e46d-47e6-9feb-a3694aa92610.png) *** ## 🏆 Trophies & Secrets 🕵️‍♀️ As you progress through the mod you'll collect different **trophies** to showcase (flex) to your friends ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_62b63dfa-76f7-4744-b8a4-4d06676fdcb1.png) You might also come across some messages left behind, some might even lead you to rare treasure ![message](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_b1792321-b332-4722-a328-31ddfc170955.png)

*** ## 👒 Cosmetics 🎣 Tired of your boring-looking rods? **Starcatcher** features a bunch of new cosmetics to spruce up your fishing! ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_4bbc8f21-1912-44e5-a865-4ec0388b4548.png) *** ## 💸 Selling Bin 💰 Turn your fish into money with [wd's Selling Bin](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wds-selling-bin). The bigger the fish, the better is sells! ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_9e0cd46e-40b1-4a13-86ad-75fe240d1c5e.png) *** ## 🏆 Fishing Tournaments! 🏆 Are you the best fisherman in all of the Overworld? Why not put it to the test against your friends with a friendly **Tournament**? ![Stand](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_0d7a2a7c-c9de-4ce4-b789-3f6b4baf7c70.png) *** ## 🍣 Farmer's Delight 🍥 [There is an farmer's delight addon available for all your fish cooking needs!](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/starcatchers-delight)

  ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_f49b31f5-8672-4ce9-abb5-201b4d2ab8c5.png) *** ## 🔧Built with Customization in Mind 👷‍♀️ Everything in Starcatcher can be costumized to fit your style. **Using datapacks you can easily:**

* Add new fishable entries * Remove or edit existing entries * Modify the treasure pool each fish has * Edit the Minigame Difficulty per-entry * Modify which items have which fishing modifiers * Modify which items act as hooks, bobbers & bait * Add new Secrets * Add new Trophies * Modify what can be sold in the Selling Bin * Modify the available Selling Bin currencies * And everything else datapacks can already modify, such as recipes, tags etc. *** ## 🌸 Built with Accessibility in Mind🌸 Not sure how to make datapacks but want to change some settings? No problem, Starcatcher undefinedfeatures a lot of accessibility settings designed to ease out the minigame difficulty for those who want a more relaxed experience.  Using the in-game config menu you can adjust global multipliers for: * Vanishing rate of vanishing sweet-spots * Moving Rate of moving sweet-spots * Missing penalty * Total fish HP * Handle speed * Swimaway speed (decay) You can also change miscellanious behaviour such as: * Disable the minigame completely * Hide catches until found * Min & Max ticks for a fish to bite * Disable tackle-box item restriction * Fish models max & min scale * Hide catches during the minigame * Hide treasures during the minigame * Enable rod durability * Enable FTB Team catch-sharing * And much more! *** ## 🐟 Compatibility 🔧 Fish from these mods are catchable with Starcatcher added to the catalogue! [!] Please note that fishing rods from these mods do not work with Starcatcher [!] v3 and above: * Tide 2 🐟 * Create 👷‍♀️ (+11 create-themed fishes) * Other mods will be added back overtime (more fish does not equal better!) v2.3 and under: * Tide 2 🐟 * Hybrid Aquatic 🐠 * Aquaculture 2 🐟 * Nether Depths Upgrade 🦴 * Fish of Thieves 🦜 * TerraFirmaCraft fishes 💀 * Sully's Mod 🧟‍♀️ * Upgrade Aquatic 🦈 * Environmental 🌳 * Collector's Reap 🦀 * Miner's Delight ⛏ * Alex's Caves 🗻 * Critters and Companions 🐛 * Aquamirae 🌟 * Fintastic 🏄‍♀️ * Spawn 🐹 * Unusual Fish Mod 🐡 * Saint's Dragons 🐉 v3+ had some major changes to the difficulty system, and as such compatibility will be added back over the upcoming updates. You can still implement compatibility yourself through datapacks. For more information on how to make a datapack head over to the wiki! *** ## 🧙‍♀️ EMI & JEI 🧲 Custom integration with Starcatcher will guide you on the more specific mechanics. The guide book does not display recipes. Using either of these mods is highly recommended. ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1357603/description_4fba4275-3cbb-4139-ab04-0aed27d1a852.png) *** ## 📘 Wiki / Guide 📝 I've recorded a video going over every feature as of v2.3 *** ## Credits There have been a lot of different artists who were either comissioned or donated their time out of their own will to contribuite to the mod! [Here you'll find](https://github.com/wdiscute/starcatcher/wiki/Credits) everyone who has contribuited to the mod's development 🐟 A special thanks to all the translators who have helped Starcatcher reach beyond the english speaking community! Interested in translating Starcatcher? Join the Discord and reach out to me! *** ## Licensing Starcatcher's Source Code is distribuited under [wd's super cool license of doom and despair](https://github.com/wdiscute/starcatcher/blob/v3-1.21.1/license). The Main Starcatcher's Fishing Rod Asset was acquired under a custom license which can be found [here](https://github.com/wdiscute/starcatcher/blob/v3-1.21.1/license_rod.pdf). Every other asset is distribuited under All Rights Reserved. If you wish to modify or use any of the assets in Starcatcher please contact me first. *** ## 🌸 Join the discord! 🌸 [https://discord.gg/tCs89QTuzn](https://discord.gg/tCs89QTuzn) - A Labour of Love by wd ♥

alexsmobs.title: Alex's Mobs
alexsmobs.body:
![Alex's Mobs](https://i.imgur.com/Se0dRBJ.png)

Alex's Mobs is a Forge mod that adds 89 new mobs to Minecraft. All of these mobs fall into either two categories: most of them are real world creatures, like Grizzly Bears, Roadrunners, Orcas, etc; but some of them are purely fictional, like the Endergade and Bone Serpent. All of these creatures fulfill a necessary purpose, and either have unique drops, mechanics or functions, as there are no purely aesthetic creatures. That said, they also help make some environments in the game feel more alive. The models, textures, animations and AI are all stylistically compatible with the vanilla game's latest additions.


The new mobs currently added are as follows (fantastical mobs in blue, real-world ones in black, boss mobs in red):
<details>
<summary>New Mobs...</summary>

#### In Release 1.0.0:

#### In Release 1.15.0 (Caves and Cliffs Update):

#### In Release 1.16.0 (Atmospheric Update):

#### In Release 1.17.0 (Fan Favorites Update):

 - Blue Jay
#### In Release 1.22.0 (Freshwater Update):
 - Caiman
 - Triops

</details>

Many of these mobs have unique drops or items associated with them. Following the traditional vanilla rules, rare or endangered animals do not have drops that can be obtained only through death. Rather, most of them, like the Komodo Dragon and Hammerhead Shark, drop their items when performing a specific function. Many of these drops and items can be used to craft unique weapons, arrows, potions, and armors with special effects. In addition, most of the mobs added are not outright hostile, but can be provoked by distance or attacking, like vanilla polar bears and piglins are. However, most of the unique, fantastical mobs are hostile.

When joining a world with Alex's Mobs for the first time, the player will be given the **Animal Dictionary**. This is a very basic guide and documentation of each creature added by the mod, and should provide insight into uses for each of the mobs or their drops.


 If lost somehow, this book can be recrafted with a vanilla book, a green dye and any item from the mod.

![Animal Dictionary](https://i.imgur.com/TEtIfTB.png)
![Animal Dictionary 2](https://i.imgur.com/tt0ew4K.png)

Alex's Mobs is intended to be used alongside other mods, including those that add new blocks, mobs, biomes and dimensions. It is **extremely configurable**, and all mob spawns can be specified by BiomeDictionary, biome registry names, dimension tags, and biome categories. This mod should play nice with biome adding mods, and should be a perfect fit for many modpacks, whether they be Vanilla-themed or extremely advanced.


Special Thanks to:

Thank you for translating our mod! If you helped out translating the mod and isn't listed here, please contact Carro1001 on discord.

Check out LudoCrypt's other music [here](https://ludocrypt.bandcamp.com/music) and [here](https://www.youtube.com/c/LudoCrypt).


If you encounter any bugs with Alex's Mobs, please report them at the github, [here](https://github.com/AlexModGuy/AlexsMobs/issues).

[Come check out our discord!](https://discord.gg/alexsmods)

📖About 📖

Supplementaries is a highly configurable Forge mod focused on adding valuable content which fills the gaps vanilla has. Its features are tailored to be functional, aesthetically viable, and complementary to preexisting content and provide many new ways to enhance your Vanilla+ experience. > The mod requires Moonlight Library
> While supported, Fabric version might be missing some minor features as the mod is mainly for Forge
> You are free to include this mod in your modpack Translated in the following languages! Deutsch | Polski | Français | Русский | Italiano | English | Čeština | 한국어 | Українська | Português | Српски | Español | Қазақ | Bahasa Melayu | Pirate Speech | 简体中文 (中国) | 繁體中文 (香港) | 繁體中文 (台灣) | Türkçe

🖼️ Media 🖼️

Check out some reviews here

❓ F. A. Q. ❓

Q: How do I disable/tweak X feature? A: Refer to the Customization section in the [Wiki](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/wiki) or join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/qk6Gy56evZ) Q: Could you update/downgrade to X version? A: I plan to eventually port the mod to every new major Minecraft version so be patient. As for downgrades absolutely no, I'm not interested in supporting older obsolete versions. Maintaining this one version already takes up so much of my time and so much changed between those versions that I would have to pretty much re-learn how to mod. Q: Could you add X feature/block? A: I would encourage you to join our Discord. We have a section dedicated to suggestions like that. If I'll feel like your idea fits well enough it will have a high chance to be eventually added. Q: How do I use X block/item? A: Once again refer to the Wiki. Q: How can I fix this issue/ crash? A: Please open a report in the Issues section always including a Crash Report. Q: Fabric version is missing X A: Supplementaries is a mainly a Forge Mod and if some feature is missing that means that it didnt have a simple or easy implementation as Fabric was missing a counterpart of something provided by Forge API that such feature was heavily reliant on. For more info check [this](https://i.imgur.com/JdipbyU.jpg).

Use code "supplementaries" to get 20% off and also support me in the process!

create_potioneering.title: Create: Potioneering
create_potioneering.body:
# Create Potioneering

Create Potioneering turns Create fluid machinery into a potion alchemy system for Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge.

Pump vanilla potion fluids through Create tanks, pipes, spouts, basins, mixers, and item drains to combine their effects into one Mixed Potion fluid. Bottle the result back into potion items with multiple effects, including drinkable, splash, and lingering variants.

## Features

* Mix Create potion fluids in Fluid Tanks, Spouts, and Item Drains
* Combine multiple potion effects into one `mixed_potion` fluid
* Bottle mixed fluids with a Spout into potion, splash potion, or lingering potion items
* Potion strength scales with the amount of each source potion in the mixture
* Similar effects merge into one entry and keep the strongest amplifier
* Instant effects such as Healing and Harming use custom scaling, so partial mixtures heal or harm proportionally
* Goggle tooltips show mB contribution, percentage, duration, and heart values for instant effects
* Bottled mixed potions show the same effect breakdown without fluid mB
* Mixed potion fluid and bottles use blended composition color
* Mixed potion fluid uses Create potion fluid textures for the animated swirling look in tanks, spouts, drains, and pipes
* Mixed potion names use a chemistry formula style based on effect composition
* Basin and Mixer support potion combining, bottle type upgrades, and duration refinement with Blaze Burner heat
* Heated mixed potions emit a low light level and bottled heated potions have the enchantment glint
* Open Create pipes and hose pulleys spray mixed potion effects onto nearby entities
* Smart Fluid Pipes can filter mixed potion fluids with mixed potion bottles or matching vanilla potion bottles

## Mixing

Fill a Create Fluid Tank, Spout, or Item Drain with one potion fluid, then add a different potion fluid to the same block. If there is room, the contents blend into a Mixed Potion fluid that carries both effects.

Additional potion fluids can be pumped into the same mixed tank to expand the composition and change the duration of each effect present.

Composition percentages are based on each effect's share of the total mixed fluid amount. A 250 mB bottle drawn from the mixture receives the same relative composition as the tank.

Potions with different refinement levels cannot mix. Unheated, Refined, and Pure mixtures stay separate.

## Tooltips

Bottled mixed potions show one line per effect:

```text
Speed I  40%  1:12
Jump Boost I  35%  0:56
Instant Health I  25%  heals 1 heart
```

Bottle tooltips show the effect name, amplifier, composition percentage, and either duration or scaled instant heart value. They do not show mB because each bottle is 250 mB.

Effects are sorted from highest composition percentage to lowest. Mixed potion names use the first two letters of each effect in that order, with ratio counts when an effect contributes more than one part.

Create goggle tooltips on tanks, spouts, and item drains show the fluid composition with mB amounts:

```text
Composition
  Speed I  354 mB  40%  1:12
  Jump Boost I  309 mB  35%  0:56
  Instant Health I  221 mB  25%  heals 1 heart
```

Goggle percentages are based on the total fluid amount in the container. Timed durations and instant heart values are scaled to what a 250 mB bottle drawn from that mixture would provide.

Bottled mixed potions can be emptied back into Create Item Drains and keep their mixed composition data.

## Heating

Heat a mixed potion in a Create Basin with a Blaze Burner to improve timed effects:

* Heated mixed potions become Refined and timed effect durations increase by 50 percent
* Superheated mixed potions become Pure and timed effect durations increase by 100 percent

Heating affects effects with durations. Instant effects such as Healing and Harming remain based on their composition amount, so their heart values are not increased by heat.

Refinement is stored on the fluid. The same potion is not boosted repeatedly by sitting in the basin. A Refined potion can later be upgraded to Pure.

## Splash And Lingering

Use Create Basin and Mixer processing with additives:

* Add gunpowder to convert a mixed potion fluid into splash type
* Add dragon's breath to convert it into lingering type

Gunpowder followed by dragon's breath upgrades a regular mixed potion to splash, then to lingering. If both additives are present in one basin operation, the final result is lingering.

The bottle type is stored on the fluid, so bottling with a Spout produces the correct potion bottle item type.

## Pipes And Hoses

Mixed Potion fluid works with Create pipe networks. Open pipes and hose pulley outputs apply the mixture's timed effects to nearby entities. Instant effects such as Healing and Harming use the same scaled heart logic as bottled mixed potions.

Smart Fluid Pipes can route mixed potions with potion filters:

* A bottled mixed potion filters the matching mixed composition
* A vanilla potion bottle filters mixed potion fluids that contain the same effect and amplifier

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge 21.1.219 or newer
* Create 6.0.0 or newer

## Status

This addon is focused on Create potion and fluid workflows. More Create machinery and edge cases will be covered as testing continues.
create_potioneering.summary: Create Potioneering adds Create based potion alchemy, letting you mix potion fluids into custom multi effect potions with blended colors, refined durations, smart pipe filtering, spout bottling, item drain mixing, and pipe spraying.

createbigcannons.title: Create Big Cannons
createbigcannons.body:
# Create Big Cannons
is an addon for Create about building big cannons that work with Create.

**Requires Ritchie's Projectile Library.** Get it [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/rpl).

#### [Join the Discord here.](https://discord.gg/vgfMMUUgvT)  

![](https://imgur.com/dx9298q.png) 

#### **What's there?**

Create Big Cannons (CBC) currently has:

*   Multiblock big cannons, built out of various cannon blocks with different materials of different tiers
*   Multiblock autocannons, for faster fire rate and more capabilities, coming in a variety of materials of different tiers
*   A menagerie of projectiles to wreak destruction with
*   Kinetic-powered cannon mechanisms to load and aim your cannons
*   Different fuze items to set off certain projectiles in various ways
*   A crafting system to build multiblock cannons using Create's kinetic system and a multiblock casting system
*   Loads of configuration, with many configuration options and datapack configurations
*   Effects to knock you off your feet and inspire terror in your foes

![](https://imgur.com/7QtjTc6.png)

#### **What can I use this mod for?**

CBC is mostly meant as a mod for multiplayer PvP servers. Use big cannons to blow up your foes' bases, valuables, and more!

![](https://imgur.com/vIVt3se.png) ![](https://imgur.com/gtpa9aB.png)

#### **What dependencies are required?**

[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and [RPL](https://modrinth.com/mod/rpl) is required.

#### **Other FAQ**

**Will older versions be supported?**

No. Porting is allowed; see [the license](https://github.com/Cannoneers-of-Create/CreateBigCannons/blob/1.18.2/dev/LICENSE.md) for more info.

 

An rbasamoyai mod.
createbigcannons.summary: A Minecraft mod for building large cannons with the Create mod.

dungeonsdelight.body:
# ![Banner for Dungeon's Delight. Contains a cloud of green smoke coming from a cooking pot with the text "Dungeon's Delight" overhead.](https://github.com/Yirmiri/Yirmiri/raw/main/mod_page_assets/descriptions/dd_banner.png)

![A blue banner with a pink trimming reading "About"](https://github.com/Yirmiri/Yirmiri/raw/main/mod_page_assets/icon/banner_about.png)

Dungeon's Delight is an addon to the popular Minecraft mod Farmer’s Delight which aims to introduce new content in the farming and cooking aspects of the game.
Dungeon's Delight expands on Farmer’s Delight with the ability to cook and monsters and earn various new status effects from them.

[![Farmer's Delight logo with the text "Requires Farmer's Delight"](https://github.com/Yirmiri/Yirmiri/raw/main/mod_page_assets/descriptions/dd_requires_fd.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-delight)

# ![Banner reading the word "Features".](https://github.com/Yirmiri/Yirmiri/raw/main/mod_page_assets/descriptions/dd_features.png)

## 🍲Monster Cooking🍲
Dungeon's Delight features a new crafting station known as the **Monster Pot**. The **Monster Pot** acts very similar to the Cooking Pot found in Farmer's Delight but must be heated by spawner-like blocks and can create new foods known as **Monster Foods** that of which all grant special new effects!

## 🔮Monster Effects🔮
Dungeon's Delight features a new alternative effect type to existing effects known as **Monster Effects**. **Monster Effects** are mutually exclusive with their normal counterparts meaning if the user tries to attain both versions of an effect the normal one will become "**monsterized**" and turned into the monster variant. **Monster Effects** keep the themeing of the original effect but flip it on it's head!

## 🔪Misc Features🔪
Dungeon's Delight features some extra side features such as the **Cleaver**, a new alternative to the knife which can be thrown or **Rotbulbs**, a new crop that must be grown in dark locations.

For exceptional server hosting services, look no further than BisectHosting. **New customers can use code "Yirmiri" to get 25% off their first month**, 
and their support team is always available to assist you in any way they can.

### Mod Integration & Compatibility

Dungeon's Delight plans to feature expansive compatibility with other mods to allow the user to continue eating on the go for whatever adventures they take! Currently Dungeon's Delight features compatibility for:

- [JEI](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jei) - Displays Monster Cooking recipes and Embedded Eggs process.
- [Aether](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aether) - New foods, knife drops from mobs, and new cleavers!
- [Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest) - New foods, knife drops from mobs, and new cleavers!
- [Miner's Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/miners-delight-plus) - Copper cup variants
- [Yapping Tooltips](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/yapping-tooltips) - Yapping tooltips for all items!
- [Appledog](https://modrinth.com/mod/appledog) - New foods.

This list does not count mods adding integration on their end! Integration for more mods may be considered in the future.

[![Banner advertising 25% off of the first month of a server with BisectHosting telling the user to use code "Yirmiri" at checkout](https://github.com/Yirmiri/Dried-Spice/raw/master/src/main/resources/assets/dried_spice/textures/description/misc/misc_bisect_code.png)](https://www.bisecthosting.com/Yirmiri?r=MR+DD)

![A blue banner with a pink trimming reading "Frequently Asked Questions"](https://github.com/Yirmiri/Yirmiri/raw/main/mod_page_assets/icon/banner_faq.png)

**Q:** I have an issue/bug I want to report, where can I do that?
- **A:** You can leave bug reports on the [GitHub page](https://github.com/Yirmiri/Dungeons-Delight/issues). Please be sure to see to both see if someone else has reported the same issue to avoid duplicates and to use proper tags when possible.
  

**Q:** I have a suggestion for the project, where can I leave it?
- **A:** You can leave suggestions for the project in [our Discord server](https://discord.gg/jmHpajd) or the [GitHub page](https://github.com/Yirmiri/Dungeons-Delight/issues), please make sure to follow the guidelines for posts/issues and use proper tags when possible.

farmersdelight.title: Farmer's Delight
farmersdelight.body: **Farmer's Delight** is a mod that gently expands upon farming and cooking in Minecraft. Using a simple cooking system and a few familiar ingredients, you'll be able to prepare a wide variety of **hearty meals**: from sandwiches to salads and stews, from beautiful desserts to mouth-watering feasts, no ingredient will be left behind in your kitchen! It also introduces a rich set of utilities: a way to **improve the very soil** your crops grow in, brand new **tools and weapons** to hunt and gather with, cute **decorations** for your builds, and many blocks and items to help you on your adventure! It's time to farm a little bit of everything! ## Getting Started **Follow the Advancements!** They explain many of the basic concepts, and are a good place to start from. Pick up any item, then press the **L** key (by default) to open the Advancements screen. Or if you prefer a more direct guide, [click here!](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight/wiki/Getting-Started) ## Frequently Asked Questions **Q. Can I use this mod into my modpack?** A. Yes! Feel free to feature Farmer's Delight in your modpack, and customize it as you see fit for the experience you're crafting. Just keep in mind: - Make sure to credit, and don't claim Farmer's Delight as your own creation; - Always read the changelogs! Minor and major versions can sometimes have breaking changes, which will be explained there. **Q. Which Minecraft versions will the mod be updated for?** A. Farmer's Delight is currently being updated for 1.18.2 and 1.19+. Any other versions are currently discontinued. **Q. Are you going to backport this mod to versions before 1.15?** A. No, this mod will never be backported to older versions. The game's older codebases are entirely different, and usually missing important features this mod depends on. **Please do NOT ask for backports!** **Q. Do you have a Patreon, or similar means of supporting your work?** A. Not currently, but thanks for your consideration! I'm currently well-sustaned by a stable job, and my personal projects are hobbies I work on my free time. My suggestion is to donate your money to more worthy causes, or just treat yourself to a nice lunch. ;)

kaleidoscope_tavern.title: Kaleidoscope Tavern
kaleidoscope_tavern.body:
# Kaleidoscope: Tavern 森罗物语：酒馆

> A Minecraft mod that brings an immersive tavern experience with a complete brewing system and rich decorative content.

![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-Java%20Edition-brightgreen)
![Forge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Forge-1.20.1-orange)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-BSD%20|%20CC%20BY--NC--SA%204.0-blue)

## Introduction

Kaleidoscope: Tavern is a mod developed for Minecraft Java Edition. This mod is committed to bringing a rich brewing experience and tavern-themed decorative content to your world. Grow grapes, craft fine drinks through a multi-stage fermentation system, and build the perfect tavern atmosphere — all in one mod.

## Features

- 🍷 Complete multi-stage brewing system with 7 quality levels
- 🍾 10+ types of drinks including Wine, Champagne, Whiskey, Vodka and more
- 🌿 Grape farming with wild grapevines, trellises, and a pressing tub
- 🪑 16-color sofas and bar stools (sit-able)
- 🏠 Rich tavern decorations: bar counter, bar cabinet, string lights, paintings and more
- 📋 Writable chalkboard and sandwich board with text alignment options
- 🔥 Throwable Molotov Cocktail

## Images

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/r9RZvhiJ/images/2dd52452074dbb9d063ace8a58795e402adaede8.png)
![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/r9RZvhiJ/images/0e8bb04dbf5aeb78c501213658f3b9a9c0e5e0b8.png)
![3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/r9RZvhiJ/images/3c5dd2b270bf77c4fc8cd1abcfee12e0ec991cee.png)
![4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/r9RZvhiJ/images/7f80bd4da2f9852cdf1a9f30146a600c33983de8.png)
![5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/r9RZvhiJ/images/9c468f09cbfea73b40ac3a154effba69266ab481.png)

## Brewing System

Grow **grapes** on trellises or find **wild grapevines** in the world. Crush your harvest in the **Pressing Tub**, then fill a **Barrel** with juice and ingredients to start fermentation.

Your brew's quality evolves over time through **7 levels**:

| Level | Quality |
|-------|---------|
| 1 | Undrinkable |
| 2 | Inferior |
| 3 | Common |
| 4 | Fine |
| 5 | Crafted |
| 6 | Exquisite |
| 7 | **Vintage** |

Once ready, attach a **Tap** to your barrel and extract the finished drink into a bottle.

### Available Drinks

- Wine, Champagne, Vodka, Brandy, Whiskey
- Carignan, Sakura Wine, Plum Wine, Ice Wine
- Vinegar
- Grape Juice, Sweet Berries Juice, Glow Berries Juice
- **Molotov Cocktail** *(throwable)*

## Decoration

- **Sofas** — 16 colors, sit-able
- **Bar Stools** — 16 colors, sit-able
- **Bar Counter** — for the classic bar look
- **Bar Cabinet / Glass Bar Cabinet** — display your finest bottles
- **Chalkboard & Sandwich Board** — write custom text with alignment options
- **String Lights** — 17 color variants for ambient lighting
- **Paintings** — featuring famous artworks and original art
- **Stepladder** — a handy decorative utility block

## Mod Compatibility

- **JEI / REI / EMI** — Full recipe category support
- **Jade** — Barrel status HUD (brew level, ingredients, next level)

## License Agreement

This project adopts a dual license agreement:

- **Source code**: [BSD 3-Clause License](https://github.com/KaleidoscopeMods/KaleidoscopeTavern/blob/main/LICENSE-CODE)
- **Resource files**: [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://github.com/KaleidoscopeMods/KaleidoscopeTavern/blob/main/LICENSE-ASSETS)

## Feedback and Suggestions

If you encounter problems or have suggestions for improvements during use, please contact us through the following methods:

<https://github.com/KaleidoscopeMods/KaleidoscopeTavern/issues>

## Development Team

**Kaleidoscope Official Production Team**

- ysbbbbbb
- tartaric_acid

---

*Thanks to all the developers and players who have supported this project.*

I've always wanted a **monster expansion**, but a lot of mob and boss mods didn't quite scratch that vanilla itch I had, so I made the mod myself! I am sorry if the quality isn't the best, I'm mostly an artist but I gave it my best :) (not all mcreator mods are reskins btw, though I understand performance concerns)

Most of the monsters added spawn on all biomes following traditional monster spawning rules, but some like the Shackled are biome restricted and the bosses need a certain item to be summoned (Ominous Hex) 

Discord server: https://discord.gg/c39DTtfGR (SPANISH and ENGLISH)
Curseforge link: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fightsfrights


- JEI or similar is highly recommended to view recipes

**Text descriptions:
**
_Mobs
_

Terrantula:

Terrantulas are the shier cousins of the Spider. They wait below ground for their prey to get close, then pounce once the time is right. If a Terrantula is hit multiple times, it may temporarily dig underground to reposition for a better attack.

Banshaa:

Banshaas are smaller, louder Ghasts from the Overworld and the Nether. They dislike direct combat, but won't hesitate to scream and lure other monsters toward their prey.

Scowl:

Scowls are said to be the monstrous winged relatives of the mythical Glare. They use their rotting insides to spit out poisonous gas clouds, and while they can fly, their wings are only used for limited steering — they rely instead on an air-filled sac that keeps them buoyant. This sac can be popped with an arrow. Scowls are found in jungles and lush caves.

Pioneer:

Pioneers are thought to belong to the Golem family of mobs, though who built them remains a mystery. They have a natural dislike for Scowls and Terrantulas, using their tough iron exteriors to make quick work of them.

Mimentis:

Mimentises are masters of disguise. Lacking any offensive abilities, they instead copy the likeness and movesets of other monsters, running away whenever their disguise is broken.

Mimic Beetle:

Mimic Beetles are colonial organisms that inhabit certain ores. These small bugs work together to form a larger, more imposing organism to defend their home. Offering them a Terrantula Leg or Gill may convince them to abandon their home and scatter.

Grimmsquito:

Disgusting warm biome farers. Grimmsquitoes spawn in jungles, swamps, and deserts, but it's recommended to avoid looking at their horrible little arthopod faces. They will fly around and inflict various harmful effects upon landing an attack.

Reanimated:

Its flesh has been reawakened by the lightning coursing through its plating. This miniboss can be summoned by striking a special structure with a Channeling trident. It strikes nearby entities with lightning, so it's best to keep your distance.

Allman:

Allmen are ancient prisoners of an unknown civilization. When attacked, they have a chance to summon help through their shackled flying creations. These creations aren't much of a threat on their own, but when they break, they leave behind a blinding cloud. They can be found in dark forests and taigas.

Seer:

Seers form when undead souls with no body converge in a single spot. They're made of a non-Newtonian jelly that hardens on impact, greatly amplifying the knockback of their attacks. Seers can be found in cold biomes and beaches.

Patuti:

Patutis are fish-like monsters often hunted for their gills. Their short stature is deceptive — they're fast, agile hunters who like to hide in humid places.

_Items:
_

Terrantula Tequeños — Teleport the player and grant Invisibility and Haste; useful for exiting caves.
Terrantula Leg — Its digging capabilities can be harvested through brewing or consumption.

Gazing — Mobs affected by this contract "Mad," becoming more aggressive, tracking from further away, and moving faster. Mad can also be applied to the player as a beneficial effect.
Averted — The opposite of Gazing: reduces mob tracking and speed via the "Calm" effect. Can be brewed with a Gazing potion and a Mimentis Claw.
Banshaa's Lungs — The mind-controlling scream can be consumed by the player or brewed into Maddening, Gazing, or Aversion potions.

Crusher — Crafted from a Scowl's tongue and other monster ingredients; turns monster remains into XP.
Golden Tongue — This air-filled tongue can be consumed to levitate like a Scowl, with a curious glowing side effect.
Monster Pop — Crafted from Golden Tongues and Jelly. When consumed, it reveals the location of nearby monsters.

VSD (Variable Speed Driver) — A block that channels charged flesh and chips into acceleration for entities.
Chip — An essential component of the Pioneer, acting as its soul. It grants experience when consumed and is used to build various technological blocks.

Mime Blocks / Reinforced Mimentis Claw — Mimentis claws can craft invisible Mime Blocks, as well as the Reinforced Mimentis Claw — a reusable, fully-enchantable pickaxe version of the Mimentis Claw.
Mimentis Claw — Used to propel yourself forward or pull mobs closer; also an essential ingredient in Bug Dust.

Mimic Beetle (item) — The lone survivor of a disbanded Mimic Beetle colony. Can duplicate ores or craft the addictive Bug Dust, though consuming it isn't recommended — withdrawal can be deadly.

Proboscis — Extracted from more exotic Grimmsquitoes. Can be thrown to inflict their respective effects or crafted into a syringe.
Forewing — Grants the player a small upward boost when used. Also a key ingredient in Bug Dust and an alternative for brewing Slow Falling.

Charged Flesh — Can be eaten for a speed boost at the cost of health, or crafted into Charged Chili for a bigger speed boost plus fire resistance.
Thunder Core — Can be thrown to strike lightning at a distance, or used to craft Charged Flesh and Ominous Hexes.

Allbomb — A classic smoke bomb.
Shackle — Harvested from an Allman's bindings; used to attack and temporarily immobilize a target.
Empty Hex — An unfilled hex — perhaps it can be filled with something.

Blunt Javelin — Made from Jelly. Deals no damage, but its knockback power is undeniable.
Jelly — Versatile due to its physical properties. Consuming it grants the Jellied effect, increasing armor and knockback resistance when hurt. There's also an explosion-resistant Jelly block set.

Pungent Soup — Made from a bone handle, a Gill, and a bowl — the world's worst-tasting food, though your saturation will thank you.
Gills — Unpleasant smell and worse taste, but grant the beneficial Amphibian effect on consumption, making water travel effortless.

Ravager Horn — Dropped by Ravagers. Can be played to gain temporary strength.
Ominous Bottle — Backported from later versions; can be crafted, or spat out along with milk, honey, or a Golden Tongue while under Bad Omen.
Elder Spine — Dropped by Elder Guardians. Can be brewed into "Guardian's Strength" (Grace + Conduit Power + Strength).

Rotten Handle — Mostly a crafting ingredient, but can be eaten if you really hate yourself.
Putrid Scythe — Not massive damage, but inflicts Poison on hit. Also works as an iron hoe.

Rotten Block — Don't step on it — the foul smell will hurt you. Mostly a way to compact rotten material and show off.
Blightcap — A mushroom that can be grown from a Rotten Block with bone meal in caves. Fully grown, it produces its own set of wood and blocks, needed for the Crusher.

Monster Salad — A "delicious" monster meal combining every effect of its ingredients at once.
Monstrous Plate — A copper alloy used to craft a variety of things, most notably an armor set that turns you into the monster.

Redstone Display — A 7-segment display showing the power of the strongest redstone line connected to it.
Circuit Lever — Outputs different redstone strengths depending on player input (shift to decrease).

Monstrous Armor — Each piece grants buffs depending on the ingredients used to craft it. Buffs mostly revolve around effects, so mixing and matching with other armor pieces gets the most out of them.

Peeping Hivestone — Found in the new "Hive" Nether biome; watchful creepy-crawlies lie within. Can be mined without Silk Touch for random ore or bug rewards.
Mystery Block — You already know what this is.

Antidote — Cures a viral infection contracted from the undead or raw meat. Crafted from any suspicious stew or flower.
Syringe — Filled with the antidote, allowing it to be injected into non-players to cure them. Requires any Proboscis to craft.

Dreamcatcher — A decoration that can be hung almost anywhere, with the practical use of rewarding players who keep a consistent sleep schedule. After waking, deposit your dreams on it to gain XP and a positive effect — just hope you didn't have a nightmare (there's a corresponding Nightmare item).

Trashcan — Dump items into it to turn them into Slop. Compatible with redstone and hoppers, so junk disposal can be automated.
Slop — A byproduct of Trashcans. Can be ignored, or used as an ugly temporary/building block.

Ominous Essence — A concentrated version of the Ominous Bottle. Curses nearby mobs when drunk, or is used to craft Ominous Plating.
Chitin — A shining component found in almost every arthropod's exoskeleton. Used to craft a variety of blocks or Monstrous Plating.

Ominous Armor — Same abilities as Monstrous Armor, but with much greater durability and protection thanks to reinforcement with Ominous Plating.

Ominous Hex — Used to summon the mod's bosses, though it won't be easy to acquire. Can be given to Piglins, Illagers, and the undead by right-clicking them with it.

_Boss Items
_

- Ominous Gem — Shoots the General's projectiles; can be used to upgrade to the Deadsteel Scimitar, which applies Poison.
- Ominous Scepter — Shoots projectiles when not fully charged. Charging it longer summons helpful "Effigies" that attack monsters.
- Ominous Tusk — Explodes on use, immobilizing anyone caught in the blast. Also makes Piglins fear the player while it's in their inventory.

**Concept art
**
![Concept Art](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e20fe63c9fe1b55bdc0bd026980efc7ff0ab1863_0.webp)

bits_n_bobs.title: Create: Bits 'n' Bobs
bits_n_bobs.body:
# TMFG users beware! If your TMFG is still on 1.2.2, you will need to swap the TMFG jar for the community edition available [here](https://github.com/Metallurgists-of-Create/Create-TFMG-CE/releases/tag/v1.2.3a). ![BITS N BOBS Title](https://github.com/Aztech-Modding/Create-Bits-n-Bobs/blob/main/vault/2.0.0%20update%20title.png?raw=true)

Small, polished additions designed to integrate closely with Create.

If you enjoy this mod, consider supporting the developer on Ko-Fi!

# Features! (All configurable) Individual features can be disabled from the config, so you can customise the mod to your liking. Config also allows you to change balancing of certain mod values. **If you want more dyeable components, install the extension mod [Bits 'n' Dyes](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-bits-n-dyes)!** ## Behaviour Tweaks ### Cogwheel wood type swapping _Compatible with all wood types and can be used on any wooden cogwheel, including addons_ ### Dyeable Fluid Pipes and Tanks _Pipes from different colours will ignore each other, **can be extended to all fluid components with [Bits 'n' Dyes](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-bits-n-dyes)**_ ### Cogwheel Chain Drives _Compatible with all cogwheels in create and many addons, providing a unique kinetic transfer option_ ## Kinetic Blocks ### Flanged Cogwheels _Flanged cogwheels can be used for creating Cogwheel Chain Drives with other materials such as Belts or Ropes_ ### Cogwheel Chain Carriage _Allows attaching contraptions to a Chain Drive_ ### Flywheel bearing _Allows smoothly rotating a contraption based on its mass, **also contains a configuration option to act as a kinetic battery**_ ### Chain Pulley _Variant of the rope pulley with a chain_ ## Decorative Blocks ### Cable Struts, Girder Struts and Weathered Girder Struts _Decorative point-to-point spanning blocks_ ### Chairs _Dyeable and dynamic chairs_ ### Nixie Tube and Nixie Board _Larger Nixie displays with a custom ornate font_ ### Tile block palletes _New tile shaped block palletes for stone types_ ### Industrial Truss, Grating Panel and Grating Block _New decorative blocks, the truss can also be used to encased pipes or shafts_ ### Headlamps and Lightbulbs _Multiple headlamps can be placed within a block, and each individually dyed_ ### Weathered Metal Girder and Weathered Metal Bracket _Completes the weathered metal block set_ ## Encasings _Piston Poles can be encased, additionally, Industrial Iron and Weathered Iron can be used for encasing blocks_ # Feature suppression In Bits 'n' Bobs, there are some features that are duplicated when running alongside other addons. To avoid confusion, Bits 'n' Bobs will suppress the duplicate in the other mod (by hiding them from creative tabs, interaction and crafting), to ensure that the rest of the content will integrate well. This behavior is configurable and can be disabled. This includes: - Wooden cogwheels from Create: Encased # Please use Modrinth ❤️ Unlike CurseForge, Modrinth shares more with creators, is open source and is a more community driven platform, notably, it has no ties we are uncomfortable with. Mods will continue to be on Curseforge, but a portion of our revenue goes towards Medical Aid for Palestinians. # As seen on Shalz! # Available Translations [Contribute on crowdin!](https://crowdin.oreostack.uk/) * Chinese Simplified (简体中文) * Portuguese (Português) * Brazilian Portuguese (Português do Brasil) * Russian (Русский) * Spanish (Español) * Turkish (Türkçe) * Ukrainian (Українська) * Mexican Spanish (Español de México) * Pirate English (Pirate Speak) ## Machine Translations Some common languages have reviewed machine translations in game, but, we would be very grateful for contributions: * Polish (Polski) * French (Français) * French Canadian (Français (Canada)) * Swedish (Svenska) * Dutch (Nederlands) # GLORY TO AZ TECH **_Created by Cake, Kipti, Astral and NormalGuy, shout mr mellz for chain drive algorithm help_**

relics.title: Relics
relics.body:
![Logo](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/778324851487801367/1117175979492773958/Base_Vector.png)

**Relics** is a little passion project that expands on Minecraft's sub-par adventuring aspect. It intends to add new diverse structures, making every journey unique and rewarding, providing new mechanics and collectables, and of course, dangers!

If you're interested in a taste of what the pack has to offer before playing yourself, check out the trailer, [here!](https://youtu.be/p0r7uICpKYw)

## Getting Started
**Relics** is meant to be something you can discover on your own. You will easily find all of its content on your own without requiring a wiki or guide, especially with each item being explained ingame! Get out there and do some digging!

## Frequently Asked Questions
**"Does <x> work with Spigot/Paper/Purpur/etc..."**
If you're having trouble with it on one of those, probably not. I have not tested it and cannot fix it.

**"Is there a way to spawn in items?"**
/loot give @s loot <pack>:item/<item>

**"When will <x> update/release?"**
I don't know, please stop asking, it will only make me take longer.

**"I'm having resourcepack problems with another datapack!"**
If you're using multiple datapacks, merge them with Weld here:
https://weld.smithed.dev/ 

## About Centerpiece
**Centerpiece** is a Data Pack library pre-installed alongside all of my (SkittishSkivy) Data Packs. All installed Data Packs that run Centerpiece must use the same Centerpiece version. This Data Pack's current Centerpiece version is: **0.1**
relics.summary: An exploration-based datapack adding new structures and magical items found deep underground

creaturefeature.title: Creature Feature
creaturefeature.body:
Here are the following Creatures, Featured in this mod. Careful, for the Feature of the Creatures is divided into 6 sections, with more to come.
![CREATURE FEATURE title image with an eeper painting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0398f240ac2091d21b4f7c605af1be6d51ae98b.png)
Eventually:tm: A fabric port will happen.
[New Age Nevermore is from the FIEND FOLIO OST](https://mistajub.bandcamp.com/album/fiendfolio-mod)
# The Galenic.
### **Minds**, The Unthinking Undead 
A zombie with an oversized brain, enrages when hit.
![A sunset. Minds is standing in the background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05b45d5cf26cc0e79c9ff504276bcb3e4c3d0f3c.png)
~~I wonder if you could pop it...~~

Appears in warm biomes, such as Savannahs, drops the same things you'd expect for a zombie to drop. With some poisonous lead if _Oreganized_ is installed.

### **Sinister**, The Mirror, rirroM
A  mass of silver tarnish, holding a mirror that reflects damage.
![A cave. Sinister's mirror is almost  taking up the entire screen.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cb7c3afafc38033a7de2e289474b1e6efa20f44.png)
~~What if you hit the mass itself?~~

Appears in deep caves, drops the mud it's made of and Silver, if _Oreganized_ is installed.

### **Beauty**, The Beauty.
A lanky humanoid plant, seems to shrug off all attacks by parrying them.
![Two beauties approaching the player in an unilluminated lush cave.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5acc45e11fccd85e13c5b6b1232d1243116afde1_0.webp)
~~What if you hit it while it's parrying another attack?~~

Appears in Lush caves, drops moss.

### **Machination**, The Raging Machine.
A small, electrum golem(?) which attacks by kicking you. Can wind up a flying kick if far away enough.
![Two machinations approaching each other in a warped forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/359c5bc55a8a7dedc68513e6f13a8f08ce3dae48.png)
~~And sometimes leaps directly into the lava below.~~

# The NeverEnding.
**All of these creatures and their features appear in the End.**
### **Eeper**, Whom dreams forever.
A distant relative of the creeper. Hops and scotches and marches directly towards you. Makes you fall asleep (slower speed, no jump, forced 3rd person) if it explodes.
![2 Eepers. one in the front and one in the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6094f47baf6c9d051e4dc577d7a088ca0018f1a5_0.webp)
### **Blitz**, Whom does not retreat.
An elemental of. Something? Some thing. often leaps, dealing damage around itself and then dashes backwards or strafes.
![Blitz moving to the left. afterimages can be seen.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c51823f0a99bfcda868a01164054654a8b949288.png)
### **MinedFlayer**, Whom floats without worry.
A cosmic jellyfish, thinking of nothing. Floats around, floats to you if it spots you.
![Minedflayer floating above an end island.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc9b2046422f4d665c2a53ff23a8a53ec8d3e4f5_0.webp)
Doesn't deal any substantial damage, only disorienting you by rotating your camera and moving the player.
### **NoThing**, Whom.
![nothing here. (Blurred image with a faint sillhouette)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/357b0733dff609566a1502a2b50e8ffb347091b7_0.webp)
<details>
<summary>The description is empty.</summary>
Upon spotting a player, it shouts, revealing itself for a moment, then runs towards the player.
It also becomes revealed upon getting hit or getting close to the target.
</details>

# The Untamed.
### **Vertigo**
**A Sickened goat(?) equine(?) pig(?) deer(?)**.
![Vertigo charging up the spit attack in a dark forest near a river.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77796761d2234b8db977705576ba549b9cd1def2.png)

Appears in dark forests, rarely in taigas. Charges towards the player as a regular walking enemy would. Rarely Sneezes(Spits?) at the player, knocking them back if caught in the attack cone and applying damage over time.
### **Canary**
**A Metallic lion(?) snake(?) bird(?) object(?)**.
![a canary in a cave charging at the camera.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b23986091c91feb9efb0ea6fe9690dd625a51cf.png)
Appears in very deep caves. Circles the player and tries to hit them with it's face plate (mask?). Inflicts delayed health loss, alongside simple melee damage.
The tail segments deal minimal damage to YOU, but the Canary takes full damage if those are hit.
### **Runaway**
**A Bigfin squid? Hermit crab? Sea skipper? Scavenger?**.
![A runaway moving towards the left of the image, as seen by the rotation. It is on a sand beach.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97b23f7cb7022d1db9b6f5365478afbf175cd16a_0.webp)

Appears on beaches. Hovers over the player and traverses terrain using it's legs. Bobs down to hit you. Has pretty weak attacks, but vast health.

Try running under it.
### **Dreamweaver**
**A Spider? Thought? Lingering moment? Sac of spiders?**
![A Dreamweaver on an end island. It is close to the camera. There is an end city in the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83848d4b7a559b788e3493aea76b038787797a56_0.webp)

Appears in the outer end, behaves similarly to a spider, becoming way more erratic after the abdomen ruptures, which ruptures after taking enough damage and spawns the enemy stored within it.

Try to throw the ones with another spider in them off the island.
# The Rangers.
### Mockingbird,
**mockingbird. mocking.   mocking bird. mock bird.**
![An image of a mockingbird floating above the player and sending out feathers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b18291336b3b0a985bf23fcf84b9694f13e59293_0.webp)
It Appears on mountains, does a revenge attack when hit and sometimes lunges backwards and throws feathers.
Strangely, it looks very humanoid.
Try moving sideways after hitting it.

### Saint Solis,
**ursa major. the stars. sunbear. st. solis. sun.**
![Image of saint solis sending out projectiles in the end](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2aec6ca6d03a5fb128dae1724a462ab49e31149_0.webp)
Appears in the outer end. Spews smaller stars from it's abdomen, oddly, the stars gravitate to YOU. But, it has a hard time aiming otherwise.
Something may happen if you let the stars hit it.

### Blossom, 
**flower. zombie.   symbiosis. as one. one as both.**
![An image of Blossom firing out a projectile in a jungle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daac60abfb88093828489ed9bd44ca7fe2ea5678.webp)
It appears in jungles, the zombie part acts perfectly the same, same as every single  day. The bud part shoots slowing sap at the target and an area around it.
Seemingly works in a pair, with the bud slowing the target while the body chases.

### Coat of arms, 
**guns. roses. flowers. coats. cloaks. capes. flowers.**
![A coat of arms firing out a wall of bullets in a single direction. It is in a swamp.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1291e5f2e5170b1a64459c74c6dfe90727fea7b7.webp)
Appears in swamps, tries to approach you from a cardinal direction and then fires.
A lot.
For some reason it ONLY fires in 90 degree angles...
# The Myths.
### Detritus 
**I once saw 2 people, They looked the same. But one was worse, way worse.**
![A horde of detriti. Some are more desaturated and disfigured than the others. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3454b988933924c2c07071daf58c8314c948d3f1.webp)
Appears in deep caves. As 1 measly zombie. It will create copies, worse than it is, if it sees you or is hurt by you.
Those copies do the same until they are unrecognizable from the original.
Otherwise, it behaves like a normal zombie would.
It is a normal person.

### Stained glass
**I once saw a bird, a beautiful glass bird, I once bled, too.**
![Image of a stained glass swooping down to the left in a desert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d29059a8fc2d529eb9ff1bdf7ba776aa9aeda018.webp)
Appears in deserts. Tries staying above you, as it is very frail. Sometimes swoops down in an attempt to land a hit, if it does, it will instantly rebound backwards to a safe spot.
You can punch it out of the air and cause it to flail on the ground for a short moment, more hits will delay the poor thing more.
### Pathogen
**I once got the common cold.**
![A really green husk. There is a second pathogen floating near it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f37056ccee08e1fad5568a95f18ee6373d598f42.webp)
Supports undead monsters by giving them a more healthy green hue and healing them. May appear already inside one of the creature.
So, it's a subcreature? Yet it can exist outside the bounds of other creatures? These things sure are a grey area.

### Toadstool
**I once saw a toad, frollicing in the fields of summer grass.**
![Image of a toadstool telekinetically throwing out a monolith to the right. The toadstool is short and ugly.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4213a2cd2299732db72763ce2b6064bab33b75c8.webp)
Uses a *Physics imbued* monolith to attack you. You can break it using a pickaxe. If you do, the little thing floors it and runs away from you, only to conjure another monolith.
May require something along the lines of *Sable.* but the mod will work without it.
Appears in open fields.
# The Friendful.
### **Fiend**, a Fully Fiendish Fella.
Appears in Nether wastes, kicks blocks at the player while approaching to attack in close range. Sometimes may carry a skeleton.
![An image of a fiend walking to the right, nether wastes are in the background ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98b8cfef2bc7a84b7cceb7b587d52085f19f0041_0.webp)

Try moving to the left or right to avoid the punted blocks.

### **Fend**, a Fierceness, Finally Full.
Appears in sunflower fields and other flowery biomes. Has 3 variants. One simply chases you, one shoots at you with a bow, one charges at you with a sword.
![A simple Fend. It is carrying a pickaxe and is hunched forward ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/717dffe3685b07c184f48db592aeda8fd5452615.png)

Even if shot with a bow, they will not infight.

### **Friend**, a Friendly, Friendly, Friend. 

Appears on the nether roof.
Your Friend, that is.
Randomly moves side to side and forwards. Your friend, that is.
![Your friend, that is. It is. Your friend. In the image. Flat plane. Your friend and a layer of bedrock.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1d317a98b0ee5139cc6eb2d40b3dbc79e2e6fae.png)

Feles pariunt. Creates Smaller versions of itself, they die after around 15 seconds or a single hit.
Goes down after being hit and flees for a moment.
